notes:
The opening asserts associativity of the extended composition by continuity. An axiomatic digression proposes a category with profinite automorphism groups and closed stabilizers of the two-sided action on morphisms. Each orbit receives a quotient topology, and Hom receives the disjoint-sum topology, making it locally compact. The manuscript explicitly cautions: “Mérite d’être fait avec plus de soin !” The action u↦guf⁻¹ is live inserted text; the older separate-action description, including sont des, is crossed. The resulting sentence lacks a fresh live verb before sous-groupes fermés, and none is supplied.

The author changes Je dis to Je veux and begins an argument for continuity of composition by testing products of orbits. The last formula is algebraically the composition of two translates, but the first factor is written Aut(Z); typing guf⁻¹ for u:X→Y instead requires g∈Aut(Y). The ink’s Z is retained. The proposed general continuity assertion has not been proved at this point; reading it is not a check. Pencil page 9.
